1.card: Master Oracle database administration — install instances, manage users, and handle backups the way real DBAs do.
1.desc: Oracle Admin I is your entry into one of enterprise IT's most dependable careers. You'll set up Oracle database instances from scratch, create and secure users, manage tablespaces, and run your first backups — the daily bread of a working database administrator. Every session is live and one-on-one, so you learn on real database problems, not slides.

2.card: Go deeper into Oracle DBA work — performance tuning, RMAN recovery, and keeping production databases healthy.
2.desc: Oracle Admin II picks up where the fundamentals leave off and takes you into the work that separates a junior from a trusted DBA. You'll tune slow queries, run RMAN backup-and-recovery drills, read performance reports, and keep a busy database responsive under load. It's hands-on throughout, built around the situations you'll actually face on the job.

3.card: Get truly fluent in SQL — from your first SELECT to multi-table joins and query optimisation.
3.desc: Almost every application on earth stores its data in a database, and SQL is how you talk to it. This course takes you from writing simple queries to joining data across tables, grouping and aggregating for real reports, and designing schemas that stay fast as they grow. You finish able to pull exactly the data anyone asks for.

4.card: Build data-driven web applications with ASP.NET MVC using clean, maintainable architecture.
4.desc: ASP.NET MVC is Microsoft's framework for building serious, database-backed web applications. Over this course you'll learn the Model-View-Controller pattern, wire up controllers and views, connect to a database, and ship a working web app. It's practical from day one, built around code you write yourself with a mentor beside you.

5.card: Ace CBSE Class 11 & 12 Information Technology with concept clarity and exam-ready practical skills.
5.desc: This programme is built specifically for CBSE students taking Information Technology in Classes 11 and 12. You'll work through the full syllabus with a personal tutor — databases, programming basics, web fundamentals and the practical file — so both your theory and your practical exam are solid. The one-on-one format means the pace matches exactly where you are.

34.card: Build enterprise Java applications with J2EE — servlets, JSP, and the backbone of large-scale systems.
34.desc: Advanced Java (J2EE) is where Java stops being a language exercise and becomes real enterprise engineering. You'll build server-side applications with servlets and JSP, connect them to databases with JDBC, and understand how large Java systems are structured. Assuming you know core Java, this course gets you to genuinely employable backend skills.

36.card: Build fast, database-backed web apps with Python and Django — from models to a deployed project.
36.desc: Django is the framework behind some of the busiest sites on the web, and it lets a single developer ship a full application quickly. In this course you'll model data, build views and templates, handle users and forms, and deploy a working Django project. You should be comfortable with Python basics; from there, this is all hands-on building.

41.card: Build dynamic single-page front-ends with AngularJS — components, data binding, and real interactivity.
41.desc: AngularJS structures the messy world of front-end JavaScript into clean, reusable components. You'll learn two-way data binding, build interactive views, wire up services and routing, and assemble a working single-page application. It's taught through building real interfaces, one-on-one, so the concepts stick because you've used them.

42.card: Run engineering simulations in ANSYS — analyse stress, heat, and fluid behaviour before anything is built.
42.desc: ANSYS lets engineers test how a design behaves under real forces without cutting a single piece of metal. This course walks you through setting up simulations, meshing models, applying loads and boundary conditions, and reading results for structural and thermal analysis. It's ideal for mechanical and civil engineers who want simulation skills employers actually ask for.

43.card: Build native iPhone apps with Swift and Objective-C — from Xcode basics to a working iOS app.
43.desc: This course takes you into Apple's ecosystem, building real apps for iPhone. You'll work in Xcode, learn Swift (and enough Objective-C to read legacy code), design interfaces, handle data, and ship a functioning iOS app. Every session is live and one-on-one, so debugging happens with a mentor right there when things break.

45.card: Program Arduino boards to sense and control the physical world — your gateway into electronics and IoT.
45.desc: Arduino is the friendliest way into electronics and embedded programming. Using the UNO and Mega boards, you'll wire up circuits, read sensors, drive motors and displays, and program the board to respond to the world around it. You'll finish having built a real working project — no prior electronics experience needed.

46.card: Design and machine 3D reliefs with ArtCAM — the tool behind CNC carving and engraving work.
46.desc: ArtCAM turns artwork into machine-ready toolpaths for CNC carving, engraving and relief work. This course covers importing and creating designs, building 3D reliefs, and generating the toolpaths that drive real machines. It's a practical, portfolio-focused course for anyone heading into signage, furniture or decorative manufacturing.

47.card: Build robust web applications with ASP.NET and VB.NET on the Microsoft stack.
47.desc: This advanced course builds web applications the Microsoft way, using ASP.NET with VB.NET. You'll construct data-driven pages, handle state and validation, connect to SQL Server, and structure an application that could run in production. It's hands-on throughout, assuming some programming background and taking you to real .NET web development.

51.card: Administer Big Data clusters with Hadoop — HDFS, YARN, and keeping large-scale data systems running.
51.desc: Where Big Data developers write jobs, Big Data admins keep the whole cluster alive. This course covers installing and configuring Hadoop, managing HDFS storage and YARN resources, monitoring cluster health, and troubleshooting the issues that come with data at scale. It's aimed at those who want the operations side of the data world.

54.card: Bridge business and tech as a Business Analyst — gather requirements, model processes, and drive projects.
54.desc: A Business Analyst is the translator between what a business needs and what the tech team builds. This course teaches you to elicit and document requirements, model processes, write clear specifications, and work with stakeholders and developers. It's a career-focused programme with the tools, templates and communication skills that land BA roles.

55.card: Handle company accounts end-to-end in Busy — India's popular accounting and inventory software.
55.desc: Busy is a widely-used accounting package across Indian businesses, especially for GST and inventory. This course covers company setup, voucher entry, GST-compliant billing, stock management and reporting — everything a working accountant needs to run the books in Busy. It's practical and job-focused from the first session.

56.card: Learn to program from the ground up with C — the language that teaches you how computers really work.
56.desc: C is where serious programmers cut their teeth, because it makes you understand memory, logic and how a computer actually executes code. This course takes you from variables and loops to functions, arrays, pointers and structures, building the mental model that makes every other language easier. No prior coding needed.

57.card: Build Windows and web applications with C# on the .NET platform — object-oriented and job-ready.
57.desc: C# is Microsoft's flagship language, powering everything from desktop apps to games and web backends. This course covers C# syntax, object-oriented programming, working with the .NET framework, and building a real application. Taught live and one-on-one, it takes you from fundamentals to genuinely employable .NET skills.

58.card: Master C++ and object-oriented programming — the language behind games, systems, and high-performance software.
58.desc: C++ powers the software where speed matters most — games, operating systems, trading platforms. This course builds on programming logic to teach classes and objects, inheritance, pointers, and the object-oriented thinking that C++ is built around. You'll write real programs throughout, with a mentor to untangle the tricky bits.

59.card: Learn both C and C++ in one combined track — from procedural basics to object-oriented power.
59.desc: This combo takes you through C first, building rock-solid fundamentals in logic, memory and structure, then into C++ and object-oriented programming. It's the complete foundation that serious computer-science and engineering paths are built on. By the end you'll be comfortable in both languages and ready for anything that follows.

61.card: Build web applications fast with CakePHP and advanced PHP techniques.
61.desc: This course pairs advanced PHP with the CakePHP framework, which handles the repetitive parts of web development so you can build faster. You'll deepen your PHP, learn Cake's conventions, work with databases and build a structured web application. It suits developers who already know some PHP and want a productive framework in their toolkit.

63.card: Become a Certified Accounts Professional — Tally, GST, taxation and real bookkeeping in one programme.
63.desc: The CAP programme turns you into a job-ready accounts professional. You'll cover accounting fundamentals, Tally Prime, GST filing, TDS and practical taxation, and the day-to-day bookkeeping a company actually needs. It's a complete, placement-focused course for anyone wanting a solid accounting career, taught one-on-one at your pace.

70.card: Train as a Certified Industrial Accountant — a complete diploma covering Tally, GST, SAP and finance.
70.desc: The CIA diploma is a deep, six-month journey into industrial accounting. You'll master Tally, GST and taxation, advanced Excel for finance, and get exposure to SAP FICO — the full stack a corporate accounts department runs on. It's built to make you genuinely employable in finance roles, with hands-on practice throughout.

72.card: Administer Salesforce — manage users, security, workflows and keep the world's top CRM running smoothly.
72.desc: Salesforce runs sales and service for a huge share of global companies, and skilled admins are in constant demand. This course covers user and security management, customising objects and fields, building workflows and reports, and the day-to-day administration of a Salesforce org. It's a direct route into a well-paid, cloud-career path.

73.card: Understand cloud computing end-to-end — the models, services and skills powering modern IT.
73.desc: Cloud computing has changed how every company runs its technology. This course explains the real concepts — IaaS, PaaS and SaaS, virtualisation, storage, and core services — and gets you hands-on with a cloud platform so it's not just theory. It's the foundation you need before specialising in AWS, Azure or DevOps.

74.card: Build custom apps on Salesforce — Apex, triggers, and development on the leading cloud platform.
74.desc: This course takes you beyond administration into Salesforce development. You'll write Apex code, build triggers and custom logic, work with the platform's data model, and extend Salesforce to do things clicks alone can't. It's aimed at those who want the higher-paid developer side of the Salesforce ecosystem.

77.card: Master Excel from basics to advanced — formulas, functions, and data analysis that employers value.
77.desc: This combined track takes Excel from the very beginning through to genuinely advanced work — formulas and functions, lookups, pivot tables, dashboards and data analysis. Excel remains the single most-requested office skill in India, and this course makes you the person in the room who can actually make it sing. Fully hands-on, one-on-one.

78.card: Build complete Android apps with Java — from your first screen to a published-ready app.
78.desc: This combo takes you the full distance in Android development using Java. You'll learn the Android SDK, build interfaces, handle data and navigation, and assemble a complete working app across the course. Taught live and one-on-one, it's the practical route into Android development, portfolio project included.

79.card: Build modern Android apps with Kotlin — Google's preferred language for clean, safe app code.
79.desc: Kotlin is now Google's recommended language for Android, and this combo builds real apps with it end-to-end. You'll learn Kotlin, the Android SDK, interfaces and data handling, and finish with a complete app you built yourself. It's the current, in-demand way into Android development.

80.card: Learn Java completely — core fundamentals through advanced enterprise features in one comprehensive track.
80.desc: This comprehensive Java course covers the whole language in one journey: core Java (syntax, OOP, collections, exceptions) then advanced Java (servlets, JSP, JDBC and enterprise patterns). It's the complete foundation for backend and Android careers alike. You write real code throughout, guided one-on-one.

81.card: Prepare thoroughly for the Computer Anudeshak (Instructor) exam with focused, syllabus-mapped coaching.
81.desc: This programme is built for candidates targeting the Computer Anudeshak (instructor) recruitment exam. It works through the computer-subject syllabus systematically — fundamentals, applications, and the topics the exam actually tests — with personal coaching so weak areas get real attention. Focused, exam-oriented, and paced to you.

83.card: Train to teach computers professionally — a full diploma in computer instruction and classroom skills.
83.desc: This year-long diploma prepares you to teach computer courses professionally. You'll master the technical subjects you'll teach — office tools, fundamentals, basic programming — alongside how to actually instruct and manage a classroom. It's aimed at anyone wanting a career as a computer teacher or training-centre instructor.

85.card: Build a rock-solid Java foundation with Core Java (J2SE) — OOP, collections and real programs.
85.desc: Core Java is the essential starting point for every Java career. This course covers syntax, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling and file work — the fundamentals every Java job assumes you know. Taught one-on-one with real coding exercises, it prepares you for advanced Java, Android or backend paths.

86.card: Build database-driven websites with PHP and MySQL — the classic, widely-used web development stack.
86.desc: PHP and MySQL still power a massive share of the web, from WordPress to custom business sites. This course teaches you to write PHP, connect to a MySQL database, handle forms and users, and build a working data-driven website. It's a practical, project-based route into web development with immediately useful skills.

89.card: Design mechanical parts and assemblies in Creo (Pro/E) — parametric CAD for real engineering.
89.desc: Creo (formerly Pro/Engineer) is a powerful parametric CAD tool used across mechanical and product design. This course covers part modelling, assemblies, and detailed drawings, teaching you to design components that hold up to real engineering standards. It's hands-on and portfolio-focused, ideal for mechanical engineering paths.

90.card: Style modern websites with CSS — layouts, responsiveness and the visual craft of the web.
90.desc: CSS is what turns bare HTML into a website people actually want to use. This course covers the box model, layouts with flexbox and grid, colours and typography, and responsive design that works on every screen. It's short, practical and pairs perfectly with HTML as your entry into web development.
